question: Can even vast material wealth justify giving this teaching to the unworthy?
premises: An ocean filled with jewels is imagined
Material wealth is contrasted with the teaching
inference: Even one who could accumulate an ocean full of jewels is not a sufficient reason to give it.
uncertainties: ratnasaṃpūrṇamakretuṃ is a fused and irregular transmitted form
plain_english: Even if one had the means to make an ocean filled with jewels.
